Bus Overturns in UP, Killing Four and Injuring Dozens

Four pilgrims died and over two dozen people were injured when a bus carrying passengers from Rajasthan to Badaun overturned on the Eastern Peripheral Expressway in Uttar Pradesh's Baghpat district early Monday. The accident occurred after the bus hit a road divider near the Badagaon cut. Approximately thirty-two passengers were on board the bus at the time of the incident.
